title: Recipe Extensions
description: Adds recipes for items that normally can’t be crafted
body:
Added new crafting recipes for several items that normally can’t be crafted in vanilla Minecraft. This update is meant to make survival progression a bit more flexible while still keeping things balanced.


- Bell
- Trident
- Totem
- Block of quartz to quartz
 

![Bell Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/007b121490697849ff5b0226f3fe71325ed002af.png)
 ![Trident Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b9049a90cbdf0fc5ac1a00a01781212d3c88343.png)
 ![Quartz Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92fc6444182ccf6cb0458df4cb54cd572a143458.png)
  ![Totem Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a22a55cdaa615175aafe860eb6b778a7572ed0e9.png)

This is just a quick early release, mainly to get the core functionality out. More recipes, tweaks, and improvements will be added soon as I continue expanding the pack. If you have suggestions for additional uncraftable items you’d like to see added, feel free to let me know. I’m planning to grow this into a much more complete crafting expansion.
